name: editorial
label: Editorial
css: .style-editorial { background-color: var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--slide-text, #111827); font-family: 'Gelasio', serif; position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; padding: 64px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; box-sizing: border-box; } .style-editorial .hook { font-family: 'Gelasio', serif; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; letter-spacing: -0.02em; max-width: 90%; } .style-editorial .text { font-family: 'Gelasio', serif; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; letter-spacing: -0.01em; max-width: 85%; } .style-editorial .step { position: absolute; top: 64px; right: 64px; font-family: 'Gelasio', serif; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); opacity: 0.08; margin: 0; line-height: 1; } .style-editorial .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 64px; left: 64px; font-family: 'Gelasio', serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin: 0; } .style-editorial::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; pointer-events: none; border: 2px solid var(--slide-primary, #111111); opacity: 0.1; } .slide-code.style-editorial { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a1a 0%, #2d2d2d 100%); color: #f1f1f1; } .slide-code.style-editorial .hook { color: #ffffff; } .slide-code.style-editorial .text { color: #e5e5e5; } .slide-code.style-editorial .step { color: #ffffff; opacity: 0.12; } .slide-code.style-editorial .brand { color: #b0b0b0; } .slide-code.style-editorial::before { border-color: var(--slide-primary, #111111); opacity: 0.2; } .slide-insight.style-editorial { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e293b 100%); color: #f8fafc; } .slide-insight.style-editorial .hook { color: #ffffff; } .slide-insight.style-editorial .text { color: #cbd5e1; } .slide-insight.style-editorial .insight-text { font-family: 'Gelasio', serif; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; color: #ffffff; margin: 32px 0; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .slide-insight.style-editorial .step { color: #ffffff; opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-editorial .brand { color: #94a3b8; } .slide-insight.style-editorial::before { border-color: var(--slide-primary, #111111); opacity: 0.25; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .style-editorial, .slide-code.style-editorial, .slide-insight.style-editorial { animation: none; transition: none; } } @media (max-width: 768px) { .style-editorial { padding: 32px; } .style-editorial .hook { font-size: 56px; } .style-editorial .text { font-size: 32px; } .style-editorial .step { font-size: 96px; top: 32px; right: 32px; } .style-editorial .brand { font-size: 14px; bottom: 32px; left: 32px; } }
